prompt: Generate a transparent orthographic six-view atlas with exactly SIX equal square columns and FOUR equal square rows. Columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. BOTTOM straight up shows belly and paw pads, no crown/face. Source three-quarter images define identity/pose only. Match independently accepted idle view camera frame. True axis-aligned orthographic, no perspective/isometric/diagonal camera. Transparent alpha zero outside silhouettes, no floor/background/shadow/grid/text/blur. No clipping.
